purpose: Compare memory mechanisms on correct reuse, assumption fidelity, discovery and total cost without turning the evaluation into a research workflow requirement.

this_delivery.synthetic_fixtures: Public development examples, not blind evaluation cases.

source_basis.authority: The proposal and this validator grant no research identity, control permission, theorem acceptance or change to mandatory project premises.

public: Already-public scientific sources at immutable versions
Redacted aggregate reports after leakage review
restricted: Unreleased evaluation prompts and adjudication rubrics
Private training examples and API responses
storage.rule: Do not copy restricted material into public Enterprise Math or Nollm repositories, including branches, PRs, CI logs, artifacts, issues and Git history.
storage.holdout_service: Separate evaluation principal and artifact permissions. A directory or branch named hidden is not isolation. If the executor can read the full private GLOBAL_KNOWLEDGE repository, placing answers in another directory there is not sufficient. The research executor, retriever, placement builder and training job must lack actual access to withheld answers.
storage.public_contamination: Public historical cases are retrospective/development cases unless access and prior exposure are explicitly controlled. Unknown parametric exposure remains unknown.
storage.export: Export only the public schema, synthetic fixtures and reviewed aggregates. A source URL is a locator, not permission to disclose its contents.

modes.name: Current compliant entry and lookup
modes.retrieval: Existing exact reads and toolbox path
modes.control: Keep current mandatory premises, stage rules and source versions.

modes.name: Bounded long context
modes.retrieval: Predeclared packing order without test-answer routing
modes.control: Record omitted material. Do not describe a packed subset as the full corpus. Any exact-source fallback is charged and logged.

modes.name: Flat result records with lexical retrieval
modes.control: Returns result-level hypotheses, status and source IDs. In a pure navigation comparison, any common frozen relation facts are also available as flat text; only graph traversal is absent.

modes.name: Dense and lexical retrieval
modes.retrieval: Frozen embedding model plus lexical retrieval; declared merge/reranking
modes.control: Dense-only and lexical-only ablations use the same source pool. Include embedding/index update costs.

modes.name: Typed relation retrieval
modes.representation: Same records plus separately recorded candidate/confirmed relations
modes.retrieval: Declared graph traversal and candidate selection
modes.control: Analogy is not implication. Keep mappings, unmatched hypotheses, source pins and relation status; candidate analogy edges are not transitively promoted. A navigation-only comparison must expose equivalent frozen relation facts to flat and vector comparators. New human/model-derived relation facts are a separate content/organization intervention, including construction and maintenance cost.

modes.name: Nollm native field navigation
modes.representation: Same independent statements and evidence; LLM-authored placement
modes.retrieval: Surface observation, selected physical entry, native bounded propagation, Access evidence resolution
modes.control: Build placement without heldout questions/answers. No keyword/object-index oracle before an allegedly native entry. Count semantic formation, placement and navigation costs. Mandatory foundation loading is distinct from a native selection followed by Access source resolution. Extra direct result retrieval is fallback even if named direct rather than fallback; native-only returned claims need full native/Access or mandatory-baseline source reads.
modes.architecture_authority: Nollm active project entry and governing original sources. This external comparison role does not prescribe Nollm internal architecture; recover design intent, rationale and implementation differences before adapting it.

modes.name: Trained premise selector or reranker
modes.representation: Same records as its untrained comparator
modes.retrieval: Frozen trained helper ranks or maps candidates; same main reasoning model
modes.control: Record training sources, cutoff and families. Compare to the same untrained helper. Training/inference costs included; does not update the main model.

optional_variants.description: A FREE_A eligible lexical view over the authorized mandatory foundation and precise definitions/conditions/tools. Exact supporting material is exposed only after a related independently formed question; no whole-result candidate menu before freezing.
optional_variants.control: Both index construction and ranking exclude the declared withheld nonmandatory result set. Pair with M0_CURRENT under the identical source identities/versions, exposure profile and fixed helper configuration. The backend name does not determine whether a view is stage-compliant.

optional_variants.description: Native navigation followed by permitted direct retrieval when needed. Report native-only and total supported results separately.
A helper that additionally reasons. Treat added reasoning compute as a separate intervention; do not attribute its benefit solely to memory.
Test stage-aware projection and question-first exact definition lookup. Full-result memory modes do not become blind merely by hiding their prompt contents.

controlled_axes.change: Raw passages versus source-faithful result records; compare the same underlying information. M0 raw-source entry versus a card-based system is normally a representation/full-system comparison, not an isolated retriever swap.

hold_fixed: Semantic facts and equivalent relation materials
controlled_axes.change: Lexical, dense/hybrid, typed relations, native Nollm navigation. M4 may not receive extra relational facts that the other arms lack when the claim is navigation-only. If relations add information, label it separately as representation/organization or complete-system evaluation.
No helper, untrained helper, trained helper; track all extra inference.
Task research, informed synthesis, relative-blind FREE A and update replay are separate tracks, not a single aggregate leaderboard.

track_rules.TASK: Use task-frozen scientific inputs and stage-permitted supporting knowledge.
track_rules.INFORMED: Result recommendations and cross-line candidates are allowed and their exposure is logged.
track_rules.FREE_A: Retain the authorized mandatory foundation, including prior results it explicitly contains. After an independently formed relevant question, exact necessary definitions/conditions/tools may be consulted before freezing. Whole-result menus and comparison/dedup remain outside this track. The helper field trained_on_project_results refers to the declared withheld NONMANDATORY result set, not knowledge already authorized in the mandatory foundation. M2_FREE_A_VIEW is an eligible optional view when its source pool and build exclude the withheld result set and all source-bearing outputs honor the question-first stage restriction.
track_rules.UPDATE_REPLAY: Replay additions, corrections, retractions and source changes in event order; no future snapshot is available early.
track_rules.unknown_exposure: Unknown training or session exposure cannot be relabelled as a certified blind run. It may remain a useful informed or exposure-unknown observation.

cases: Different notation for same declared object
Candidate needing a missing bridge condition
Independent slot errors versus correlated event failure
Conditional model versus native event law
Old source remains valid only historically
Record-only identity fields must not become live authority
Relative-blind FREE A with allowed exact lookup

sampling.units: Research/dependency families, not randomly shuffled paragraphs or near-duplicate theorem restatements.
sampling.temporal_split: Pin knowledge available before each replay cutoff. Reference outcomes and later corrections are withheld from build, retrieval, placement, training and solving.
sampling.family_split: Keep near-duplicates and shared proof-dependency families on one side of train/development/test. Also evaluate genuinely new premises.
views: Restricted future or newly authored heldout set
sampling.freeze: Freeze manifests, modes, model versions, prompts, permitted tools, budgets and grading rules before heldout runs.
sampling.labels: Support multiple valid dependencies/proofs. Reference labels are evidence for adjudication, not the sole permitted research route.
sampling.sequential_testing: Pilot data sets the task-specific non-inferiority margins and required sample size. Freeze them before confirmatory testing; use a prespecified stopping rule and preserve unsuccessful runs.

shared_controls: Same exact main-model revision when claiming memory-only benefit
Same mandatory foundation and task source versions
Paired task assignment and randomized mode order
New isolated sessions for first-answer tests
Compare the actual eligible source identity/version/kind/role/classification manifest, not only a snapshot label
For memory_only, fix the complete helper configuration and exposure profile; helper changes use learned_helper with a frozen candidate pool
For navigation-only claims, freeze all semantic facts including relation material across flat/vector/graph arms
cold_warm: Cold: new executor/session, first eligible index load, no answer cache
Warm: persistent index/cache with declared previous exposures
Update: warm state after a declared source change
execution.runtime_isolation: Restrict network and repository views to the frozen allowed corpus for historical replay; evaluator-only storage is inaccessible to the research process. Validate actual access, not just a caller-supplied boolean.
execution.failures: Keep timeout, budget exhaustion, unavailable dependency and abstention as explicit outcomes. Do not silently drop failed runs.
execution.fallback: Allow the same declared direct-source fallback opportunity across comparison arms; report whether success came from native memory, fallback or both.

comparison_semantics.memory_only: A content-representation or navigation intervention with fixed main model, helper, eligible sources, resource envelope and exposure profile. It does not by itself establish pure retrieval causality; identify which representation/navigation axis changes.
comparison_semantics.learned_helper: A separate comparison of helper capability under the same allowed sources, main model, exposure and candidate_pool_id. Freeze the candidate artifact as well as its identifier before running.
comparison_semantics.full_system: M0 raw-source workflow versus a card/graph system may change representation and organization together. Report these factors and total build/maintenance costs; do not attribute all benefit to a retriever.

execution.declared_exposure_channels: Audit read, title_preview, preview, error_output, tool_output and source_exposure, including each source_id/source_ids and exposed_to principal. Reject unknown source-bearing event types rather than treating them as no exposure. Undeclared runtime content requires a separate instrumentation/access audit.
execution.native_trace: Record native_select with selection_id and selected source IDs, then a full read via native/access_after_native with that selection_id. Separate mandatory-baseline reads from additional direct or fallback result lookup. A title preview alone does not support a full returned scientific claim.

correct_reuse: Recall of necessary/valid alternative premises within actual reading budget
Verified useful reuse in the resulting research step
Rate and severity of wrong hypothesis/model/quantifier/status transfer
evidence: Exact source resolution at the declared version
Native evidence contribution versus fallback contribution
exploration: Distinct problem structures after expert blinded reading
Feasibility and substantive novelty relative to allowed knowledge
resource: Provider-reported billed tokens, cache and reasoning usage when available
End-to-end wall latency and p50/p95 by task class
Incremental maintenance cost per source update and affected dependency
measures.aggregation: Report paired per-family uncertainty intervals and task-class results. Report quality-cost/latency frontiers. Do not force a single winner across heterogeneous tracks.
measures.unknowns: Unreported billing or internal compute remains unknown; visible-token counts cannot be converted into a proved total-cost saving.
measures.total_cost: Report build + incremental maintenance + all inference/tool costs. If amortizing build/training costs, publish workload horizon and also unamortized totals.
measures.scaling: Measure at multiple frozen corpus sizes and update batches. Include relation candidate generation counts; do not assume all-pairs connections or logarithmic navigation costs.

gates: Public output contains no restricted material
Heldout answers are outside research/build/train principals
Immutable source IDs and actual status are preserved
Relative-blind track rejects result menus and result-trained recommenders
Native and fallback contributions are attributed accurately
acceptance.threshold: Zero observed violations on the explicit mechanical/sentinel cases. This does not prove absence of all natural-language errors or actual isolation until runtime access tests pass.
acceptance.effect: Eligibility for a restricted experiment only.

gates: No unacceptable increase in serious assumption or source errors
Unknown cases are handled without invented transfer
acceptance.threshold: Prespecified task-specific non-inferiority margins and paired family-level uncertainty. Every curated critical incompatibility sentinel must be correctly handled.
acceptance.effect: Quality qualification for the tested scope.

gates: A reproducible improvement in correct reuse, total cost or latency at acceptable quality
Update and maintenance costs are included
No concealed oracle or fallback benefit
acceptance.threshold: A meaningful Pareto improvement or a declared benefit for a task class; no arbitrary universal savings percentage.
acceptance.effect: Choose modes by actual workload; retain the baseline where it wins.

gates: Allowed foundation and source exposure are preserved
No material unexplained collapse into existing hotspots
Informed synthesis yields useful candidate connections
acceptance.threshold: Blinded expert assessment with structural, not merely textual, diversity; report uncertainty and adjudication disagreements.
acceptance.effect: Separate decisions for informed exploration and relative-blind FREE A.

gates: Memory failure leaves direct scientific work usable
Updates invalidate only affected views while preserving history
Default changes follow project deployment and source rules
acceptance.threshold: Measured limited-scope shadow use followed by a deliberate adoption decision.
acceptance.effect: No automatic policy or production change from a benchmark score.

comparator_record.note: The supplied Python checker validates this proposed declaration contract against synthetic examples. It is not an evaluator, access-control mechanism, theorem checker or live benchmark.

field_notes.helper.trained_on_project_results: Exposure to the declared withheld NONMANDATORY result set. Mandatory inherited foundation may already contain earlier results and remains allowed. A boolean declaration is not proof of actual training exposure.
field_notes.attribution: Mandatory baseline loading, native selection plus Access resolution, and extra direct/fallback retrieval are distinct. Every observed extra direct/fallback source is declared as fallback. Native-only returned claims need a full native/Access or mandatory-baseline read, not only a preview.
field_notes.sources: Each eligible source has id, identity/locator, immutable version, kind, knowledge_role, classification and available_at. A matching source_snapshot_id cannot excuse differing source manifests.
field_notes.exposure_profile: Declares stage, mandatory_source_ids and allowed lookup conditions; FREE_A also identifies the withheld_nonmandatory_result_set_id. A comparison fixes the whole profile as well as prior_result_exposure. FREE_A baseline kinds are foundation and current_governance only; task_input remains valid for TASK but is not a FREE_A baseline, build source or exposure shortcut.
field_notes.build.used_withheld_results_for_index_or: Must be explicitly false for FREE_A, including M2_FREE_A_VIEW. Precise supporting material can be indexed only within the eligible view; exposure still needs a previously formed related question.
field_notes.events: Source-bearing visible outputs use source_id/source_ids and a recognized exposure type. Unknown source-bearing events and unsupported source aliases are rejected; declarations do not reveal content that is never logged.
field_notes.helper: memory_only fixes the full helper object. learned_helper may vary it but requires the same frozen candidate_pool_id and all other shared source/model/exposure controls.

references.use: Premise selection, hard negatives and generalization to previously unused premises; not a requirement to formalize all project research.
Evaluate associative retrieval and direct factual retrieval separately; graph structure is not an automatic improvement.
Training use of retrieved evidence and distractor rejection; not evidence of improved original project mathematics.
Evidence placement in long context is an empirical issue; older-model findings are not a current-model score.
